finding: POST /api/v1|v2/app/locations is a valid anonymous read endpoint that hydrates requested locations and returns three linked collections: locations, tariffs and currencies.

evidence.empty_object: HTTP 412: Missing or invalid locations list
evidence.empty_location_object: HTTP 200 with the same three empty collections

interpretation.locations_parameter_role: The locations array is very likely a list of internal AMPECO location identifiers to hydrate, not a free-text station search or EVOne connector identifier input.
interpretation.important_schema_signal: A successful response is explicitly partitioned into locations, tariffs and currencies, which is directly useful for Charge Companion once valid internal location IDs are discovered.
interpretation.next_step: Find the anonymous map/discovery request that supplies internal AMPECO location IDs, then feed only those public IDs into /app/locations and sanitize station/status/tariff fields.
